protocols.title: Protocols
protocols.body: Single Piece creates one asset from the brief. Variations preserves the base piece and creates alternatives. Restyle preserves content and uses another reference for visual language.

references.title: Using references
references.body: Choose references compatible with the Work's role and confirm their origin. A visual reference guides composition, color, and rhythm; it is not an automatic source of facts.

contentStyle.title: Content versus style
contentStyle.body: Use the base piece for brand, product, offer, CTA, and other facts. Use a style reference only for visual direction, without copying claims or text.

inference.title: Inferences and unknowns
inference.body: The system separates provided facts from visual inference and keeps unknown values when there is no evidence. Review the inferred brief before generating.

failures.title: Failures
failures.body: When a source, preview, or generation fails, retry or replace the material. Failure is not approval and should not hide the next step.

approval.title: Approval
approval.body: Review the result and objective verdict. Inconclusive or legacy items require human confirmation; failed items need another attempt.

welcome.title: Studio is open
welcome.intro: Account confirmed. {credits} credits in Studio — no card, no expiry. Three things that save you a redo:
welcome.step1: Write the brief for real. Objective, audience, offer. A vague request comes back as rework.
welcome.step2: If you have a reference — brand, product, a Piece that already works — attach it. Without it the model fills the gap, rarely in the brand's actual voice.
welcome.step3: Generate a batch. Then decide what ships. You choose; AI does the operational work.
welcome.close: If you get stuck, reply to this email. I read it.
welcome.reason: You received this email because you created an ADScale account.
welcome.text:
Hi {firstName},

Account confirmed. {credits} credits in Studio — no card, no expiry.

1. Write the brief for real: objective, audience, offer.
2. Attach a reference if you have one.
3. Generate a batch, then decide what ships.

Studio: {url}

If you get stuck, reply to this email.

Best,
Jhonatan
Founder, ADScale
